name: JevK5
context_scaling: Inherited unchanged from Qwen/Qwen3.5-4B (config.json max_position_embeddings 262144). This derivative does not publish a context-extension recipe of its own.
attention_variant: Inherited unchanged from Qwen/Qwen3.5-4B: 8 full GQA layers (kv heads 4, head_dim 256) and 24 other layers, per the base config.json.
notes: ADDED 2026-10-25. A finetune of Qwen/Qwen3.5-4B, not a new base model: same config.json, same 4.206 parameters . Recorded as a contender because it publishes benchmark evidence against its own base; the evidence rows below are card-sourced and marked vendor_claim. Licence apache-2.0, repo created 2026-09-22.

benchmarks.name: JevBench v1.2 hard tier
benchmarks.config: Card JevBench table row 'hard (public half)' n=111: untrained Qwen3.5-4B base column 0.613 vs JevK5 v0.3 0.784. The standard tier regresses (0.986 base vs 0.944) and easy ties at 1.000, so only the hard tier is recorded. Decision readout via the SemIf protocol, not generate().
